known_edge_cases.description: Affiliation axis labels (Non-Affiliated Issuer, Emerald JV LP, etc.) appended with pipe delimiter starting 2025-12-31. Stripped by canonical_strip_re for position key stability.
Numeric suffixes (1, 2, 3, ...) distinguish different loan tranches to the same borrower. These are separate positions, not duplicates.
Emerald JV LP and Verdelite JV LP sub-portfolios appear as separate rows from direct portfolio. Same underlying positions may appear under both direct and JV schedules.

Many positions appear twice per quarter with slightly different FV values, likely current-period and prior-period facts from the same XBRL filing. Up to 4x duplication in early quarters (2022-12-31) from period x dimension cross-product.
Placeholder identifiers 'Investment One' through 'Investment Seven' with FV=0, likely unfunded commitments or template rows.
JV entity rows (BCRED Emerald JV LP, BCRED Emerald JV) appear as aggregate-level entries with no rate/maturity/shares detail, representing entity-level fair values rather than individual positions.
The Dreyfus Government Cash Management Institutional Shares identifier is a retained cash position. Source context c-6032 in accession 0001803498-26-000031 reports FV and cost of USD 11,462,000.

Standalone Emerald JV LP and Verdelite JV LP pipe suffixes within InvestmentIdentifierAxis identify the underlying reporting portfolio. Parent LP-interest names without this suffix remain parent records.

Earlier InvestmentIdentifierAxis members carry the reporting portfolio as its own comma- or ordinal-separated segment, trailing or (2023-03-31) leading, or (2023-09-30 through 2024-03-31 only) as a bare-space-separated trailing segment with no comma or digit immediately before the label. Reviewed contexts: MH Sub I c-4761 in 0001803498-24-000007 and c-4323 in 0001803498-24-000022 (Verdelite JV LP after a legal name); 2U, Inc. ie581ddde7a204a18ab795e21c813585b_I20230331 in 0001803498-23-000012 (leading Emerald JV LP); Freeport LNG Investments, LLLP c-3470, Monk Holding Co. c-3527, Confine Visual Bidco c-3506 and Symphony Technology Group c-3548 in 0001803498-23-000017; AlixPartners, LLP c-4526 in 0001803498-23-000021; Auris Luxembourg III S.a r.l. c-3820 and Tangerine Bidco S.p.A c-3997 in 0001803498-24-000044. Bare-space contexts: Polyphase Elevator Holding Co. c-3367 in 0001803498-23-000021; Auris Luxembourg III Sarl c-3689 and c-4713, Corporation Service Company c-3813, Alterra Mountain Company (double space) c-4730, Confine Visual Bidco c-3831, Freeport LNG Investments, LLLP c-3801, Jayhawk Holdings, LP c-3928, Box Co-Invest Blocker, LLC c-3923 and GSO DL Co-Invest EIS LP c-3924, all in 0001803498-24-000007. Borrower legal-form words are not required. The fund's own BCRED Emerald/Verdelite JV LP interests and joint "and" forms (leading or trailing) remain parent records; both guards are load-bearing once the bare-space form is admitted. This scope interpretation does not strip the ordinal from the position identifier.

reading_rules.label_pattern: bcred (emerald|verdelite) jv( lp - lp interest)?|specialty lending company llc - llc interest
label_examples_match: BCRED Emerald JV LP - LP Interest
BCRED Verdelite JV LP - LP Interest
Specialty Lending Company LLC - LLC Interest
label_examples_no_match: WHCG Purchaser III, Inc, Emerald JV LP
BCRED Emerald JV LP - LP Interest 2
reading_rules.evidence: The fund's own interest in its joint ventures (BCRED Emerald JV LP, BCRED Verdelite JV LP; the same entities the legal_entity_members and reporting_entity_suffixes declarations name as JV schedules) and in Specialty Lending Company LLC to 2023-06-30. The printed line has cost, fair value and percent of net assets, no instrument column, rate or units; e.g. 0001803498-26-000031 c-1420 'BCRED Emerald JV LP - LP Interest | (6)(16) | 1/19/2022 | 1,836,000 | 1,539,677 | 3.41'. 33 contexts, 2022-09-30 to 2026-06-30. Production publishes all 33, and the fund's published total misses the filed total investments by their value without them. Owner decision D15, 2026-11-19. Slice 2 Task 6.

reading_rules.label_pattern: .+ - (class a common units|series a preferred units)|pigments lp int
label_examples_match: GSO DL Co-Invest EIS LP (EIS Acquisition Holdings, LP) - Class A Common Units
GSO DL CoInvest CI LP (CustomInk, LLC) - Series A Preferred Units
label_examples_no_match: BCRED Emerald JV LP - LP Interest
reading_rules.evidence: Co-invest and LP equity lines with no units tagged (cost, fair value and percent of net assets only). 11 contexts, 2022-09-30 to 2023-06-30: GSO DL Co-Invest EIS LP and GSO DL CoInvest CI LP units in each quarter (two of them, 2022-09-30, in the Emerald JV schedule), and Pigments LP Int (0001803498-23-000017 c-878, fair value 0). E.g. c-876 'GSO DL Co-Invest EIS LP (EIS Acquisition Holdings, LP) - Class A Common Units | 558 | 2,779 | 0.01': no units printed. Production publishes all 11 (9 published, 2 in the JV schedule). Owner decision D15, 2026-11-19. Slice 2 Task 6.

The filed total investments line leaves out the money-market and cash-management rows of the schedule. Measured 2026-11-23 on the build of 2026-11-22, all 16 quarters 2022-09-30 to 2026-06-30: in the 14 quarters with cash rows (1 to 5 rows, 13.8m to 1,183.4m) the published total without them equals the filed line within 2,000 dollars and with them misses it by the cash rows; the other two quarters (2022-12-31, 2023-03-31) have no cash rows and tie. No quarter ties with cash in. The evidence rule (owner ruling 2026-11-04, check A04) cannot confirm this because the financials file holds no filed cash-equivalents figure for the fund. Taken from the numbers; the printed schedules were not read. Owner decision D16, 2026-11-23.

Owner ruling B, 2026-11-23: in this filing an interest-rate tag filed above 1 in a ratio unit (pure or utr:Rate) is already a percent; it is kept as filed, not multiplied by 100. Values at or below 1 in the same filing stay fractions. Measured 2026-11-23 on the warehouse build of a39354a8 with ruling A (warehouse/scripts/rate_rulings/q_b_scale_evidence.sql and q_b_scale_forms.sql): 1 row filed above 1 (11.45, pure); its printed number equals the tag read as a percent and its cell prints c-3847 '11.45% (incl. 4.00% PIK)'. 0 printed missing, 0 disagree. Applied per row: a row whose own print does not agree stays scale_not_decided (int_rate_scale; re-checked on every build by tests/rate_scale_rule_evidence.sql). Author: Claude (implementer agent), on the owner's ruling.
